summary.business_type: Non-profit community organization (Publisher + Local Service hybrid)
top_findings: robots.txt sitemap URL points to fossandhra.org (dead domain) — only 1 page indexed in Google
Zero meta descriptions across all 17+ pages
No JSON-LD structured data on any page
Blog and Events pages render as empty shells (JavaScript-rendered, not crawlable)
No canonical URLs, no OG tags, no Twitter Card tags
quick_wins: Fix robots.txt sitemap URL: change fossandhra.org to fossap.in (5 min)
Regenerate sitemap with fossap.in base URL (15 min)
Add Organization JSON-LD to app/layout.tsx (30 min)

findings.title: Sitemap Domain Mismatch in robots.txt
findings.description: robots.txt at fossap.in points to https://fossandhra.org/sitemap.xml which does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN). Sitemap URLs also use fossandhra.org domain. Google has only indexed 1 page.
findings.recommendation: Update public/robots.txt to Sitemap: https://fossap.in/sitemap.xml and regenerate sitemap with fossap.in base URL.

findings.title: Blog and Events Content Not Crawlable (JS-Rendered)
findings.description: Blog shows 'Loading...' and Events shows 'Loading events...' in static HTML. Search engines cannot index any blog posts or events.
findings.recommendation: Convert blog and events to Next.js Server Components or use ISR to pre-render content at build time.

findings.title: No Canonical URLs
findings.description: No <link rel="canonical"> found on any page. Risk of duplicate content from URL parameter variations.
findings.recommendation: Add canonical tags via generateMetadata() in each page's metadata export.

findings.title: No Security Headers
findings.description: Missing X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, and Content-Security-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers in next.config.js using the headers() function.

findings.title: Sitemap URLs Reference Dead Domain
findings.description: fossap.in/sitemap.xml contains 17 URLs all pointing to fossandhra.org — a domain that does not resolve.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate sitemap using fossap.in as baseUrl. Use next-sitemap package.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No structured AI-readable entry point for AI crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt with organization description, programs, and key URLs.

findings.title: Zero Meta Descriptions Site-Wide
findings.description: Not a single page across the entire 17+ page site has a meta description tag. Google writes its own snippets which are often suboptimal.
findings.recommendation: Write unique 150–160 character meta descriptions for every page using generateMetadata().

findings.title: Blog Has No Indexable Content
findings.description: Blog listing page renders as empty shell. All posts are loaded client-side and invisible to search engines.
findings.recommendation: Implement SSR/ISR for blog listing and individual post pages.

findings.title: Thin Content on Program Pages
findings.description: FOSSynC: ~280 words, FOSStorm: ~350 words — both below the 400-word minimum for indexable content. Several other program pages may also be thin.
findings.recommendation: Expand each program page to 600+ words with: program history, outcomes, testimonials, step-by-step participation guide, and related events.

findings.title: Events Has No Indexable Content
findings.description: Events page is a JS-rendered empty shell. No past or upcoming events are crawlable.
findings.recommendation: Server-render events with ISR. Even a static list of past events would provide crawlable content.

findings.title: No OG / Twitter Card Tags
findings.description: Zero social sharing metadata. All pages show blank previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or WhatsApp.
findings.recommendation: Add openGraph and twitter fields to generateMetadata() globally and per-page.

findings.title: About Page Lacks E-E-A-T Signals
findings.description: About page is ~450 words with no named team members, no founding dates, no partner institutions, no media mentions.
findings.recommendation: Add team bios, organizational timeline, partner logos, and any press mentions.

findings.title: Duplicate Title Tag on Privacy Policy
findings.description: Title reads 'Privacy Policy | FOSS Andhra | FOSS Andhra' — organization name duplicated.
findings.recommendation: Fix to 'Privacy Policy | FOSS Andhra'.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Events page has unique descriptive title
H1 tags present on all audited pages

findings.title: Multiple Pages Missing Unique Title Tags
findings.description: FOSStar, FOSServe, FOSSynC, FOSStorm, FOSStart, Contact, Contribute, and Membership pages all fall back to the homepage default title tag.
findings.recommendation: Add generateMetadata() export to every page component with a unique, keyword-rich title.

findings.title: No Open Graph or Social Sharing Tags
findings.description: Confirmed absence of og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card on all pages.
findings.recommendation: Implement via Next.js generateMetadata() globally.

findings.title: Footer Headings Appear in Page Heading Hierarchy
findings.description: About page H2 list includes 'Programs', 'About', 'Contribute', 'Legal' — these are footer section headings bleeding into the page's semantic heading structure.
findings.recommendation:
Change footer column headings to

or elements with font-weight styling, not

/

.

findings.title: Local Geo-Modifiers Missing from Program Page Titles
findings.description: Program pages miss opportunities to rank for local searches with 'Andhra Pradesh' or 'Vijayawada' in titles.
findings.recommendation: Include state/city in title tags where relevant: 'FOSSynC — Student FOSS Clubs in Andhra Pradesh | FOSS Andhra'.

findings.title: No Structured Data on Any Page
findings.description: Zero JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa found across the entire site. No Organization, Event, Article, FAQPage, or BreadcrumbList schema.
findings.recommendation: Implement Organization/NGO schema in app/layout.tsx as the highest priority, then FAQPage, Event, and BreadcrumbList.

findings.title: FAQ Page Has No FAQPage Schema
findings.description: 12 well-structured questions exist on /faq with no FAQPage JSON-LD. Missed AI citation opportunity.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage JSON-LD for AI Overview / Perplexity / ChatGPT citability benefit.

findings.title: No Event Schema on Events Page
findings.description: Events data is not marked up with Event schema — missing local event rich results.
findings.recommendation: After fixing JS-rendering, add Event JSON-LD to each event.

findings.title: Client-Side Data Fetching Delays LCP
findings.description: Blog and Events use client-side fetching, showing 'Loading...' and delaying LCP by 1–3s on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Switch to Server Components or ISR for data-heavy pages.

findings.title: No Performance Baseline Established
findings.description: No PageSpeed Insights data available. Cannot confirm current CWV thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights for mobile: https://pagespeed.web.dev/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffossap.in and establish a baseline.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers permitted via robots.txt
Clear mission statement citable from homepage

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No structured AI-readable entry point exists. AI crawlers must parse the entire HTML to understand the organization.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt (see geo.md for recommended content).

findings.title: No Entity Structured Data for AI Knowledge Graph
findings.description: Without Organization/NGO JSON-LD, AI systems cannot confidently build a knowledge entity for FOSS Andhra.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema with sameAs links to social profiles.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Logo has alt text across instances
Team photo on About has alt text

findings.title: Social Media Icon Alt Text Unknown
findings.description: Footer social media icon SVGs/images may lack accessible aria-labels or alt text.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-label to all social media icon links: <a aria-label='Follow us on GitHub'>.

findings.title: No OG Image Defined
findings.description: No og:image tag means social shares show no preview image.
findings.recommendation: Create a 1200x630px branded OG image and reference it in metadata.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Technical Fixes
items: Fix robots.txt — change sitemap URL from fossandhra.org to fossap.in
Regenerate sitemap.xml with fossap.in base URL
Submit sitemap to Google Search Console
Add canonical URLs to all pages via generateMetadata()
Add meta descriptions to all 17+ pages
Fix duplicate Privacy Policy title tag
Add Organization/NGO JSON-LD to app/layout.tsx

phases.name: Phase 2: On-Page & Social Optimization
items: Add unique title tags to all pages missing them (8+ pages)
Add OG and Twitter Card tags globally
Create branded 1200x630 OG image
Add FAQPage JSON-LD to /faq
Create /public/llms.txt
Fix footer heading elements (h3 → p/span) to clean heading hierarchy
Add BreadcrumbList schema to all program pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Rendering
items: Convert Blog to SSR/ISR — make posts crawlable
Convert Events to SSR/ISR — make event listings crawlable
Expand FOSSynC page to 600+ words
Expand FOSStorm page to 600+ words
Expand About page with team bios and timeline
Write and publish 5 blog posts on FOSS topics
Add Event JSON-LD to events
Add security headers in next.config.js

phases.name: Phase 4: Authority & Monitoring
items: Set up Google Search Console and monitor index coverage
Run PageSpeed Insights monthly and track CWV
Create Wikidata entry for FOSS Andhra
Build citations from Deccan Chronicle, NDTV Tech, The Hindu
Add testimonials and case studies to program pages
Cross-link related programs and resources internally
